review.scope: Five Agent runtime files plus matching tests; no ASL/SQL adapter, catalog, public API or SSE schema changes.
checks: Task boundaries and dependency completion precede extraction and metric cleaning.
Per-task intent shares batched parameter inference; no intent-only model call.
Global intent and seven visible stages preserved by existing critical contract tests.
Question-level dependency edges target all terminal tasks after expansion.
Local operations use executable contracts; unavailable related details remain database queries.
Keyed order inputs align by proven SQL identity, including one-row keyed samples; true scalar denominators still work.
Remote period-series intent routing and time sorting retained unchanged; other remote files not published.
